scores.rationale: Niche out-of-print Horner collector reference; typically $30-80 to thimble and hatpin collectors.
Modern Asian-cast decorative Atlas bronze on marble with common repro signature; heavy and decorative, realistic $120-250.
Three common modern omnibus reprints; Annotated Alice only valuable if a 1960 first, which is unlikely, so lot mostly under $40.
Standard 1970 Tasmanian architecture reference, two volumes, worn jackets; about $100-180 the set.
Boxed LV ring-bound sketch album looks genuine; resale a few hundred if real, discounted for fake risk and used condition.
Signed, numbered 615/1000 Tasmaniana reference in two volumes; collectors pay roughly $150-300.
French repeating carriage clock with alarm, unsigned; $300-600 if running, discounted for unknown condition and no maker.
Unmarked treacle-glaze Kitchener jug, possibly Launceston pottery but unconfirmed, with glaze losses; roughly $40-100.
Signed John Campbell 1933 large vase but with repaired handle and glaze losses; realistic $100-200.
Lalique dove dish only partly legible signature, many fakes about; genuine around $120-250, mix gives mid range.
